from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[k for k,v in c.items() if v>=max(H,W)]
    line=[k for k in colors if any(all(x==k for x in r) for r in g) or any(all(g[i][j]==k for i in range(H)) for j in range(W))][0]
    obj=[k for k in colors if k!=line][0]

    scol=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==line for i in range(H))]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    oset=set(pts)

        shift=n_min-min(cs)
        for i,j in oset: out[i][j-shift]=obj
        oset={(i,j-shift) for i,j in oset}
        ncs=[j for i,j in oset]; nrs=[i for i,j in oset]
        colmax=max(ncs); colmin=min(ncs)
        line_col = colmax+1 if max(ncs)>scl else colmin-1
        for i in range(H): out[i][line_col]=8

        sr=srow[0]

        nrmax=max(i for i,_ in oset); nrmin=min(i for i,_ in oset)
        line_row = nrmax+1 if nrmax>sr else nrmin-1
        for j in range(W): out[line_row][j]=8
    return out
